book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel Moalamangnindna Andra, Yesusna Nemelmom Hoanavho Vrulangalm.

content: Annind Annind Kristusnindva Kusovna, Isholm Moam Yerusalemra.

Wo monglava indhanamba ambvna Antiokram Yutia provinsrini. Doa himba osoa numhowol vivna Yutanindna meisnindmba, temba Kristustindilmba pethanamba, os, yemba si lopshavavmoa, yimba hutovpa koaihangamba owai vitava, Mosesva kamba osm numhowol vena.

Wo heva os Poli Barnapasiva ohovunvna nomba moamba, wo tandwol evena no indhanamba noindava. Wo Kristusnindva indkumbiva ningvna, wolanga velm Poli Barnapasimba mongla indhanahonam Yerusalemram. Di himba daha ihishunvma mindnamba honamba moalamangnindm eva kuwulm Kristusnindnam.

Kristusnind hemba wolanga vina, engavnamba. Himba men os engana Ponisia petha hovmonam, eva Samaria provins monam, nom ihisho wulenginvna, ona, Yutanindna meisnindva os hevmba weihaloh avramana vena Sesoaindamba. Wo honindava Kristusnindva und lothoprana indkumbiva.

Wo nonamba himba ephovnamba Yerusalemrava, Kristusnind, moalamangnind eva kuwul hemba englisra holvorumbtina. Poli Barnapasi hev, eva mongla indhana eishunvna manam manam, nom ten wonvenam Sesoa hevm, nonam hev andra vaomana evevnam os hindkembel, hindkembel.
Heva os mongla Kristusnind opulvona, noi seilm ten avnam Varisilm. Hev unnam, Yutanindna meisnind Kristusnindoa hutovoa kueira. Pioa ishuluhunda, engalm lohohmom Mosesnam.
Moalamangnindna kuwulnamba kusovna, nom moam naengho vrelm.

Himba nom moam os naengho vrowoloh vrinamba, owai. Doa Pita phonamba, unna, seh, yimba nonora av, nomba temba nemetva doarava venamba. Sesoa pusvundthoana kamba yerinimba, wulluhunilm indhanam besal nemelmom Yutanindna meisnindm. Himba hillina besal nemelmomba kainda, wo himba undnahonam av daipotava.

Sesoa, himba nonorangas woheinv nengavnangmba indhananamba, indlothunna, hemba vetva vralmba, hevtindilmba saivolmba. Himba nithinna honamba pimba osm, Sesoasongolm daswolna hem, os men pim vinnam doara.
Noinda pimba nonora, Sesoana novrava nomba indhanamba indatovnamba einvmoa. Nonamba himba undnahonamba lovahthamnanamba, himba hemba kilumb shuawol vev hevna indkoklariniva.

Wo manaram yimba lihvna Sesoamba? Yimba kinmba mendekli ohuhlinv wangrava Yutanindna meisnind pina mongawa Kristusnindmba, sna moanamba. Kinmba mendekli, os pi eva pina simbehumunna eindhumunna, nemet ten he wulangvnam os owai, es eva ata.
Wo os kava nengv, vei, pi eva he, pimba si lopshavav wavrana mendekli Yesusna, Mosesna lohohmorava owai.

Wo doa nomba indkumbiva vena sesese. Himba ambo hilwiluvna, Poli Barnapasi ihishovnam. Poliva Barnapasiva ihishunvna nom manam manam mendekliandram, eva nom inethalm, ten Sesoa hev vinvnam Yutanindna meisnindhovra Polina Barnapasina moara.
Himba ihisho epiennamba, Yems eva wulkoho. Hev unna, seh, hillu kam.
Simonmba pimba ishuni, oi, Sesoava os nithinna seilnonoava hevna undmba Yutanindna meisnindmba. Himba hemba sowona hevelm, kekaiv vena Polina Barnapasina moara.
Wo moamba moashulnindnamba lohohra honi mongawulm elohna, Sesoa mendekli ona,

content.text: Devittindimba os plel vena, ona, lairduvm nombspev. Wo heva os kava henga si provav, henga kovhora vevav. Kava si henga vevav nemel, temba mueisowa venamba, wo kava si wilundthoavav sena.
Noinda Yutanindna meisnindva osva hind, hind, hind, heoa osoa seihminivra kamoa, kolvrowolalm.
Nemet doara doa kava ishona, osva ona, honamba si os phovav. Amos 9:11-12

content: Yemsva mendah Kristusnindm ishungeinvna, ona, Sesoava hona moarava os ona, kava si henga nambavav Yutanindna meisungundmba. Wo noinda kava os nengv, pimba manam indkokla vewol vivav Yutanindna meisnindmba pina lohohmonamba, temba himba keknamba amnavpa Sesoamba.
Osoa mama pioa ambo tombai novol vipingiluhunda hemoa. Pioa honam ishuluhunda,

content.text: Manam innemba hlavav yimba, nomba temba tihsongomba suwesengrava teihinvrava. Nomba lehv innemba sahoklalm Sesoana novrava. Manam yimba limbihlavav tovolva. Manam yimba kuhaphorava, ongariskui vilangavra. Manam yimba tatamba hlavav tetovolnamba.

content: Himba honamba nisva mana vemava manam vivav, manara noinda nemet doara, eva veiva, daipota men, indhanamba angu vev indakonda kotarava, no hindungund, no hindungund, himba hevmba numhowol viv lohohmona Mosesnana. Manara, doa doara heva boaita una moamba Mosesnamba Yutanindna vahiaevul okombanam.
Tombai Novol Vipinginna Kristusnindm Yutanindna Meisnindm.

Moalamangnind, kuwul eva indkumbi Kristusnind ningvna, wolanga velm vivna hevrinim indhanam Poli Barnapasimongo Antiokram. Wo himba kikih vruwulna Sailasim, Yutasim, Yutasna nihilva mongova Barsapas lohvna. Hona indhanarini samblamba indkumbiva longong vruwulvna.

Wo himba tombaiva vreihunnamba, himba os englana wulengana. Os novol velohv, Seh, ka moalamangnind eva kuwul Yerusalemrava, pevna mongawa Kristusnind. Kava yemba novol vewol vipiprinv moamba, yimba kana mongawa Kristusnind av Yutanindna meisnindva Antiok kotara, Siria provinsra, eva Silisia provinsra.

Kava os hillina, monglava indhanamba kariniva ambinnamba yeindamba, wo eishunvna yemba, hutovm koaihangalmba, osm noinda yimba phosohna sahonamba, wo eva yimba hona moara viluwuldakaka vev. Wo heva os owai, kava wuhtinamoa, ishunilmba yemba osva honamba.
Wo noinda kava mongawund vrina, kikih vewolalmangas monglam indhanam, wo wolamb vina yeindam. Himba si vivra, pivna Poli Barnapasimongo,
himba hevmba eworumbtrohona, andra venalm pivna mendekli Yesus Kristusm.
Wo doa men kav wolamb vev Yutasimba Sailasimba hemongo. Himba si ihishunvav yemba mongawamoa.

Sesoasongol wonav kamba, kava moamba doa woheuk vrina os, honamba memba Sesoasongol kamba ishunna, wo kava noinda kinmba plothunvavmoa yemba, Mosesna lohohmonamba. Wo noinda osva yeoa ambo honamangas wohengivm.

Manam yimba hlavav innemba, nomba temba suwerava taihinvrava tihsongomba. Manam yimba limbihlavav tovolva. Manam yimba tatamba hlavra tetovolnamba. Manam yimba kuhaphorava, ongariskui viliangavra. Yimba ehallava honanapenamba vetava, yimba si osva kanandhivav. Doata beswonam avm.
Wo doa himba vinamba Yerusalemriniva, os angana Antiokramba. Wo Antiokrava himba huhul vivna Kristusnindmba, wo os vreihunna tombaiva hemba.
Nonamba himba boaita unnamba, himba und kanandhaprana, manara noinda undnahonam keknam alm pikihwolmoa no tombairava temba.
Yutasiva Sailasiva eva moashulnindrinilm oholohvnata, himba eva pikihwolmoa ihishunvnata Kristusnindmba, wo vewol evevna, alm keknam.
Wo sismba hengava Yutasimba Sailasimba wolanga vina beswonam undwonamangas. Himba engana henga, dom ten henoi wolamb venam hevm, Yerusalemrini.
Heva os Poliva Barnapasiva di ahana Antiokra. He eva mongla numhowol vewuvna besal nemelmona indhanam mendeklina moam.
Poliva Barnapasiva Os Momong Evewohana.

Simba penngiliha vunganamba, mongnasiva Polva omnana Barnapasmba, pivva ihishomana evinvna mendeklina moamba no kotara no kotara yunalm. Pioa henga nungsis vaomana evei no indakonda kotaramoa, es dihi Kristusnindva viv?
Barnapasva waingalm vevna Yon Makmba ella nihra.
Wo heva os Yon Makva doara bumbrislihangana hemba Pampiliarini, himba wohpetheinnamoa hemba, waiandra vaomanalmba. Wo noinda Polva osva nengvna, owai, manam eva ata waiengavav hemba.
Wo Poliva Barnapasiva sahonam ohononglawolna hevmba noinda. Di momong evewohanamba, indakonda indamonam engawolna. Barnapasva Yon Makm omnanamba, botra waivonganamba, os waingana Saiprusram.
Polva Sailasm pethanamba, os waingana. Kristusnindva Antiokrava wuleihina Polmba mendeklina englisra.
Wo doa os wailohmana vungana Siria provinsram eva Silisia provinsram, henga pupul vewolalm no Kristusnindm nonindm nonindm.
